V Pizza - Authentic Italian Brick Oven Pizza & Restaurant V Pizza - Authentic Italian Brick Oven Pizza & Restaurant Menu Events Our Story Catering Locations Our Bars Get The Sauce V for Victory In the Press Ship V Pizza Gift Cards CONTACT US Order Online WELCOME TO V PIZZA Order Online View the Menu SHIP V PIZZA About V Pizza At V Pizza, we make authentic pizza Napoletana , sourced from the highest quality ingredients. It has crispy edges and a softer center, so eating it with your hands can get messy. Try eating it with a knife and fork instead of in slices, the way they do in Naples. Keep in mind our food is meant to be shared, just like the Italians do. If your food comes out before someone else’s, offer them a bite of yours! We have no microwaves, range tops or heat warmers because we cook everything in our imported Italian brick ovens. They are truly the most important ingredient in our pizza. But of course, the sauce from San Marzano tomatoes, bufala mozzarella and Prosciutto di Parma are delicious too. Everything is delivered hot and fresh directly to your table. Buon Appetito! Our Ingredients View Our Menu Find A Location View All Locations Don’t Bring Home Our Pizza Unless You’ve Got the Stones to Do it Right. Because our dough has ZERO artificial ingredients, our pizza must be eaten right out of our oven for true authentic flavor. If you plan on bringing one home, we strongly suggest (like really, really strongly) you purchase one of our pizza stones. They’re only $20 and last forever. And, it’s the best way to recreate that same V Pizza flavor at home. Here’s how: Place the stone in your oven and crank it as high as it goes. Put your pizza on the HOT stone for 60 seconds. And boom! You’re back in Naples eating pizza the way it was intended. Molto Bene! FAQs - Pequod's Pizza About Us FAQs Merch Chicago Menu Reservations Order Online Morton Grove Menu Reservations Order Online Suburban Delivery Private Events Select Page Frequently Asked Questions What style of pizza is Pequod’s? Pequod’s Pizza is pan-style, a close variant on Chicago deep-dish style pizza. Which Pequod’s is the original? Our Morton Grove location is our original location, opening back in 1970. Do you have parking available? Street parking is generally available for both our Chicago and Morton Grove locations. Do I need a reservation? We always recommend making a reservation through our partner Tock, as walk-in availability is limited. On short notice, you can call the restaurant for current availability. What are your hours? The Chicago location is open Monday – Saturday: 11am – 2am and Sunday: 11am – 12am. In Morton Grove, the hours are as follows: Monday – Thursday: 11am – 9:30pm, Friday: 11am – 1
[...]
 Saturday: 12pm – 11:30pm, Sunday: 12pm – 9:30pm. Are you wheelchair accessible? Yes, both Pequod’s locations are wheelchair accessible. Please let us know about any mobility constraints that would prevent your party from using stairs. Do you have outdoor seating? The Morton Grove location has outdoor seating available as weather permits. Do you offer Take-out or Delivery? We do offer both Take-out and Delivery options. *Take-out and delivery pizza orders will be uncut to ensure the highest quality pizza. If you would like your pizza cut, please specify when ordering. Do you ship your pizzas? We ship our pizzas nationwide throughout the U.S. and Canada with Goldbelly . How do you pronounce Pequod's? Pee-kwaadz . When is it busiest during the week/day? Our busiest day is Saturday, and our peak hours are typically the dinner rush between 6-8PM. How far in advance should you reserve a table? ajor Chicago events (like the Chicago Marathon), these lead times are longer. Where do I pick up my Take-out order? You will receive a check number via email or text message when your order is ready. In Chicago, Take-out orders are available for pick up at the host stand. On Friday & Saturday from 4pm – 9pm and Sunday from 5pm – 8pm, all Take-out orders are available at Whale Tale just two doors down from Pequod’s. Can I pre-order? You can place orders for Take-out and Delivery in advance by calling the restaurant or ordering online at order.pequodspizza.com. Due to health department regulations, standard dine-in orders cannot be placed in advance. Do you have gluten-free crust options? We do not currently offer any gluten-free crust options for our pizzas. Do you offer vegan cheese? We do not currently offer cheese alternatives as an option for our pizzas. Can I order a partially cooked pizza to finish at home? Ordering a pizza half-baked is a great option if you don’t want to eat our pizza right away. We will partially cook your pizza and you can finish cooking it at your convenience. We stock a few “grab-n-go” half-baked options at all five locations. These sell on a first come, first served basis. If you have a special half-baked pizza in mind, please call ahead to place your order. Side note: Zachary’s half-baked pizzas travel well! Customers regularly drive and fly pizzas all across the country- and even overseas! Bring some Bay Area pizza love to your far-away friends and family. How do I cook a half-baked pizza? Make sure the pizza is at room temperature. Do not take the pizza directly from refrigeration and try to cook it! Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Take the pizza out of the box and slide it from the cardboard circle onto a buttered cookie sheet. Place the pizza on the middle rack of the oven and bake it until it becomes golden brown. Thin pizzas will cook in 10-15 minutes. Stuffed pizzas will cook in 15-20 minutes. **We do not recommend freezing our pizzas! Do you take reservations? Yes, we do! A : Our CLASSIC pizzas bake up well at a preheated 450 degree oven placed directly on the rack. If you prefer a softer crust, consider using a baking sheet instead of directly on the rack. Q: Do I need to thaw the pizza before baking? A : No, we suggest placing the frozen pizza directly in a pre-heated oven. Q: I purchased a cheese pizza and baked it upside down in my oven. How can I tell the difference from the top and the bottom for next time? A : Unlike our competitors, we par-bake our pizzas. The bottom has pinholes in the crust. A: Apart from the milk used, no other ingredients of animal origin are used. The only allergens in the plant are wheat and milk. They are listed on the box below the ingredient statement. Product Info Q: What is Tavern-Style Pizza? A: Tavern-Style pizza is characterized by its crispy thin crust and its square slices, setting it apart from traditional pie cuts. The name “Tavern-Style” comes from the pizzas originally served in taverns, designed to make customers thirsty. Bartenders would cut the pizza into small square pieces and serve it on paper napkins. This clever approach encouraged guests to snack for free while enjoying a cold drink. Q: Where can I purchase Home Run Inn pizza? A : Our frozen pizza is available at most local retailers.
